About

I am a Year 4 Applied Mathematics undergraduate interested in applied machine learning and its applications across different domains. My work relates to numerical simulation, computer vision, sports analytics, and AI-assisted education.

Publications & Manuscripts

Neural Curvature Estimation for Two-Phase Flow Simulations

First-author manuscript · In preparation

Supervisor: Dr. Jiaqi Zhang (BNBU)

Neural interface-curvature estimation for multiphase flow, connecting learned local geometry with numerical simulation in Basilisk.

My work details

JAN 2026 — PRESENT

  • I generated approximately 83.5 million labeled samples across five grid resolutions and trained neural curvature estimators.
  • I evaluated cross-resolution transfer, reinitialization sensitivity, and unseen flower-shaped interfaces. In matched-resolution tests, the models reduced MSE by factors of 5.6–260 relative to second-order finite differences.
  • I converted trained networks into standalone C routines and integrated them into Basilisk’s CLSVOF solver, evaluating stationary bubble, capillary wave, and rising bubble cases.

Python · PyTorch · C · Basilisk

Arrow Selection for Elite Series Arrows

Equal-contribution co-author · Submitted to Sports Engineering (JCR Q3, IF = 1.4; 2025)

Project leads: Prof. Huaxiong Huang · Dr. Jiaqi Zhang (BNBU)

High-speed motion analysis and physical measurements for data-driven selection of competition-grade arrows. Research at BNBU’s digital sports research center, 2025–2026.

BNBU project overview ↗

My work details

JUL 2025 — MAY 2026

  • I conducted controlled shooting tests and multi-orientation shaft-deflection measurements.
  • I developed high-speed-video analysis to extract launch velocity, launch angle, and trajectory deviation.
  • I built and manually validated a dataset linking physical measurements, shot kinematics, ring scores, and impact locations to support quantitative arrow comparison.
  • I co-authored the manuscript with equal contribution.

Python · OpenCV · High-speed imaging · Statistical analysis

Research Experience & Projects

Automated Arrow-Impact Localization & Ring-Score Recognition

Computer Vision · June 2026–Present

Supervisors: Dr. Lidong Fang (SUFE) · Prof. Huaxiong Huang (DKU)

A vision pipeline for detecting arrow impacts and recognizing ring scores under practical shooting conditions.

My work details

JUN 2026 — PRESENT

  • I developed the data curation, annotation, model-training, and evaluation workflow.
  • I explored a ResNet-based formulation before adopting a YOLO baseline, trained on annotated public data and evaluated on self-collected target images.
  • I investigated image preprocessing and augmentation. The best preliminary configuration achieved precision and recall above 70% on self-collected images.

Python · PyTorch · YOLO · OpenCV

AI-Assisted Education System

AI Engineering · September 2025–March 2026

Supervisor: Dr. Jiaqi Zhang

A teaching-support system that turns course materials into editable lessons, assessments, and presentations through retrieval-augmented generation.

My work details

SEP 2025 — MAR 2026 · REMOTE RESEARCH INTERN

  • I structured teaching materials using MinerU/OCR and integrated embedding, reranking, and chat models through SiliconFlow and Ollama.
  • I implemented editable assessments with five question types, three difficulty levels, natural-language revision, and DOCX export.
  • I integrated tool execution for multi-step tasks and deployed the system internally with Docker.

Developed at Wanhoo Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.

Python · RAG · MinerU/OCR · Docker
